data.description: Review the exact one-shot GitHub OIDC/Sigstore publisher, candidate binding, deterministic release manifest, permissions, action pins, and no-resume/no-replacement behavior.

data.body: INFO: The whole publish gate rests on the protected 'release' environment requiring a human reviewer and restricting to main. The workflow verifies GITHUB_REF=main but cannot enforce the environment's reviewer/branch policy — that is a repo setting. Confirm required-reviewers and deployment-branch=main are configured, or dispatch becomes a self-approve path for anyone with write access.

data.reason: Keyless provenance publisher verified: SHA-pinned actions, least-privilege per-job perms, no shell injection, run_attempt==1 no-resume binding, downloaded bytes re-checked vs approved digests, fail-closed tag/release/attestation burn, draft readback. No security issues.
Live GitHub readback confirms release requires reviewer bobisme and exact main branch deployment policy 58172766.
